html: China imploded into regionalism due to the Flood and India faced a similar crisis as well. Japan already had an advanced aerospace industry and a need for raw resources to feed it. Thus they were in a position to be the only other power capable of develop assets on the Moon and Cislunar Space. However, after WWIII, the US seized Japan's territory in space and banned military operations by rival powers, effectively claiiming the moon and the rest of the Solar System for themselves.
